incidents.name: Cream Finance (AMP reentrancy)
incidents.notes: crAMP market: ERC777-style reentrancy through AMP token transfer hooks during borrow. Market listed ~2 months before.

sources.ref: onchain review (no exploit tx: incident block located by binary-searching eth_getBlockByNumber to measurement.incidentTimestamp -> ethereum block 13126750, 2021-08-30T12:00:00Z). The crAMP market 0x2Db6c82CE72C8d7D770ba1b5F5Ed0b6E075066d6 is a Compound-fork CErc20Delegator created at block 11820452, 2021-02-09T05:54:41Z: it emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, so the previous deployment basis (202.3d) was wrong. Its implementation pointer lives at storage slot 18 (`implementation`, per the verified named layout from cast storage) and every change emits Compound's NewImplementation(address,address). eth_getLogs over [creation, incident] returns SIX of them: block 11820452 2021-02-09T05:54:41Z -> 0xc9d8a3b9c39b71969280fc249c87b5d0cb77f3c9 (CErc20Delegate, set at construction); 12199012 2021-04-08T12:00:38Z -> 0xe9ea58efb13733d413365f02ea52b21d25f0ceb6; 12199804 2021-04-08T14:52:48Z -> 0x852dc31074d42beb1ee8fba7829cb5bd4d68aaf3; 12200860 2021-04-08T18:43:33Z -> 0xcc44572b57372dac502bcd784705e083779b2afc; 12471013 2021-05-20T11:29:39Z -> 0x8dc840cead11a46f59c65b1697698a2b60fa0789; and last, 13107006 2021-08-27T10:39:14Z -> 0x3c710b981f5ef28da1807ce7ed3f2a28580e0754 (CCollateralCapErc20Delegate). A binary search of eth_getStorageAt on slot 18 independently puts the last change at block 13107006. Age measured from that last implementation swap: 264046s (~3.1 days), not the 202.3 days implied by the delegator's deployment.
exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (block 13125071; crAMP victim in receipt logs), cited by PeckShield and the DeFiHackLabs 2021-08 index

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2021-08-27T10:39:14Z (block 13107006): NewImplementation(0x8dc840cead11a46f59c65b1697698a2b60fa0789 -> 0x3c710b981f5ef28da1807ce7ed3f2a28580e0754, CCollateralCapErc20Delegate) emitted by the victim CErc20Delegator itself; corroborated by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt on slot 18 (`implementation` in the verified named layout), which last changes in that same block

incidents.name: Cream Finance crYUSD price-per-share manipulation
incidents.notes: The crYUSD market priced its collateral from yUSD's pricePerFullShare, which the attacker doubled by donating the underlying Curve LP directly into the yUSD vault, so the same yUSD collateral supported twice the borrowing power - the market itself behaved as written.

sources.ref: onchain review: crYUSD 0x4BAa77013ccD6705ab0522853cB0E9d453579Dd4 created 2021-06-01T02:56:49Z by 0x197939c1ca20c2b506d6811d8b6cdb3394471074, unrelated to the attack sender 0x24354d31...; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between creation and the incident (Cream cTokens change implementation through the Comptroller's own _setImplementation, and none fired for this market), so age runs from deployment: 1635342850 - 1622516209 = 12,826,641 s (148.5 days). Loss ~$130M as reported. This row upgrades the previous SCOPE_ONLY placeholder for the same incident.

re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. CErc20Delegator: `implementation` is storage slot 18 (slot 17 is `underlying` = yUSD 0x4B5BfD52124784745c1071dcB244C6688d2533d3). Slot 18 held 0x1c8645bec146ae9a3489fc5821b69c9191577331 at all 25 sample points across [12546046, 13499798]; the only NewImplementation(address,address) on the market is the 0x0 -> 0x1c8645be write in its creation block; and callTracer on the exploit tx shows the market delegatecalling only that implementation, which has zero DELEGATECALL opcodes. The only storage that moved is slot 3 (packed decimals+admin: admin 0x6d5a7597896a703fe8c85775b23395a48f971305 -> 0x3fae5e5722c51cdb5b0afd8c7082e8a6af336ee8), not the code pointer.
